headline: Dances With Robots, and Other Tales From the Outer Limits

headline: Researchers Look to Create a Synthesis of Art and Science for the 21st Century
snippet: Article on California Institute for Telecommunications and Information Technology, or Calit2, $400 million research consortium at University of California, San Diego, assembled over last five years by astrophysicist Larry Smarr; 'collaboratory,' at university's new Atkinson Hall, is connected by fiber-optic cables to rest of campus and to smaller partner laboratory at Irvine campus as well as to research centers around world; laboratory, designed for 900 faculty and student researchers, has two separate wings, one an ultrasterile set of nanotechnology clean rooms and the other a new digital media arts center where Calit2 scientists, engineers and artists can display their projects; Smarr, in interview, says synthesis of art and science is vital in light of role he expects artists to play in designing the future; photos (M)
